title: Mouse Echocardiography Protocol
author: Chee Lim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yyifxue

steps.title: Prepare Mouse Chest
steps.instruction: Remove chest hair to ensure clear ultrasound coupling.

substeps.instruction: Apply a topical depilatory agent (e.g., Nair) to remove remaining body hair.

steps.title: Position and Sedate Mouse
steps.instruction: Secure the mouse in the appropriate position and maintain sedation if required.

substeps.instruction: Hold the conscious mouse in the prone position to decrease vagal reflexes and heartrate/AV conduction abnormalities.
If anesthesia is required: sedate with 3% isoflurane.
Place the sedated mouse in a supine position on a heated platform with embedded ECG leads (Visual Sonics).
Place a nose cone over the snout and deliver 1% isoflurane to maintain sedation throughout the procedure.

steps.title: Perform B-mode Imaging
steps.instruction: Capture two-dimensional B-mode views of the heart.

substeps.instruction: Apply ultrasound coupling gel heated to 34°C to the chest area.
Position a linear array transducer (18-23 MHz) using a Vevo 2100 (VisualSonics).
Obtain parasternal long and short axis views at the mid-ventricular level.

steps.title: Perform M-mode Imaging
steps.instruction: Capture one-dimensional M-mode images for cardiac measurements.

substeps.instruction: Obtain M-mode images in the short axis view to measure cardiac wall and chamber dimensions.

steps.title: Analyze Cardiac Measurements
steps.instruction: Perform off-line measurements and calculations from M-mode images.

substeps.instruction: Measure LV chamber size and wall thickness from at least three consecutive beats and average the results.
Measure intraventricular septum (IVS) and posterior wall (PW) thickness at systole and diastole.
Measure LV internal dimensions (LVID) during systole and diastole.
Calculate LV percent fractional shortening (FS) and ejection fraction (EF) from the M-mode measurements.
